title: Harry Potter season fondue (white Meltie mug, fireplace) — restage 03
notes: Restage 03 of shorts/uMl76XX7epo: WHITE variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photos), the treats on the reclaimed-wood coffee table (a reclaimed-wood coffee table in a living room at night, a stone fireplace with a crackling log fire and a wooden mantel with candles behind) instead of the white desk in front of red curtains. Table decor kept (pumpkins, gnome pumpkin, candle jar, laptop). Reworded hook. The pour and the last dip spill on purpose (brief). hook: When the evenings get darker and
it's Harry Potter season at last
